maddeler.e:
أتعاصر (form VI)
# أَتَعَاصَرُ (ʔataʕāṣaru) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.sˤa.ru/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَعَاصَرَ (taʕāṣara)
# أَتَعَاصَرَ (ʔataʕāṣara) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.sˤa.ra/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَعَاصَرَ (taʕāṣara)
# أَتَعَاصَرْ (ʔataʕāṣar) /ʔa.ta.ʕaː.sˤar/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَعَاصَرَ (taʕāṣara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
